default.title: Getting around
default.body: Use the sidebar to switch areas, the project selector to focus on one project, and Search (Ctrl+K) to jump to any record, screen or action you're allowed to use.

lab.title: Design system lab
lab.body: These pages show every Stage 1 building block in English and Urdu so they can be reviewed and tested before business screens are built on them.

forms.title: Forms
forms.body: Labels stay visible, hints explain the format, and errors appear under the field and in a summary. Your entries survive language changes and going back and forward.

tours.title: Guided tours
tours.body: Start, resume or replay a tour. Every tour also has a text version that works without the spotlight.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.body: Change language, motion, contrast, sound and how guided tours are offered. Changes apply immediately.

planned.title: Planned screens
planned.body: This address belongs to a screen in the register that is scheduled for a later stage. It is listed so that links never lead to a dead end.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.close: Close a dialog, drawer or menu
shortcuts.skip: Jump to main content (first Tab on a page)

related.title: Related records
related.intro: Records connected to {{name}}. Each link opens its own workspace.
